verdict.rationale: Shortcut's REST API is explicitly versioned in the URL path (v3), and the docs include a migration note for moving from /v2/ to /v3/, so versioned APIs are documented. No evidence shows a formal deprecation policy, such as sunset timelines, notice periods or support windows for older versions. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines, a changelog or version lifecycle guarantees, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: To update, simply change the `/v2/` in your URL paths to `/v3/`.
